# PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY] Contents of this Part

## Part not to apply where claimant uses Part 8 procedure

## 15.1.  This Part does not apply where the claimant uses the procedure set out in Part 8.

## Filing a defence

## 15.2.  A defendant who wishes to defend all or part of a claim must file a defence.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.2.  A defendant who wishes to defend all or part of a claim must file a defence.] (Part 14 contains further provisions which apply where the defendant admits a claim.)of not filing a defence

## Consequence of not filing a defence

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > Consequence of not filing a defence] 15.3.  If a defendant fails to file a defence, the claimant may obtain default judgment if Part 12 allows it.

## The period for filing a defence

## 15.4.—(1) The general rule is that the period for filing a defence is—

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.4.—(1) The general rule is that the period for filing a defence is—] (a)14 days after service of the particulars of claim; or

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.4.—(1) The general rule is that the period for filing a defence is—] (b)if the defendant files an acknowledgment of service under Part 10, 28 days after service of the particulars of claim.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.4.—(1) The general rule is that the period for filing a defence is—] (2) The general rule is subject to rules 3.4(7), 6.12(3), 6.35, 11 and 24.4(4).

## Agreement extending the period for filing a defence

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > Agreement extending the period for filing a defence] 15.5.—(1) The defendant and the claimant may agree to extend the period for filing a defence specified in rule 15.4 by up to 28 days.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > Agreement extending the period for filing a defence] (2) Where the defendant and the claimant agree to extend the period for filing a defence, the defendant must notify the court in writing.

## Service of copy of defence

## 15.6.  A copy of the defence must be served on every other party.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.6.  A copy of the defence must be served on every other party.] (Part 16 sets out what a defence must contain.)

## Making a counterclaim

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > Making a counterclaim] 15.7.  Part 20 applies to a defendant who wishes to make a counterclaim. Where a defendant serves a counterclaim the defence and counterclaim must, other than for good reason form one document with the counterclaim following the defence.

## Reply to defence and defence to counterclaim

## 15.8  If a claimant files a reply to the defence—

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.8  If a claimant files a reply to the defence—] (a)the claimant must—

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.8  If a claimant files a reply to the defence—] (i)file the reply with a directions questionnaire; and

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.8  If a claimant files a reply to the defence—] (ii)serve the reply on the other parties at the same time as it is filed; and

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.8  If a claimant files a reply to the defence—] (b)the reply should form one document with any defence to counterclaim, with the defence to counterclaim following the reply, unless the dates on which they are due to be filed differ from one another.

## No statement of case after a reply to be filed without court’s permission

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > No statement of case after a reply to be filed without court’s permission] 15.9.  A party may not file or serve any statement of case after a reply without the permission of the court.

## Claimant’s notice where defence is that money claimed has been paid

## 15.10.—(1) Where—

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] (a)the only claim (apart from a claim for costs and interest) is for a specified amount of money; and

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] (b)the defendant states in his defence that he has paid to the claimant the amount claimed,

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] the court will send notice to the claimant requiring the claimant to state in writing whether the claimant wishes the proceedings to continue.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] (2) A copy of the claimant’s response must be served on the defendant at the same time as it is filed.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] (3) If the claimant fails to respond within 28 days after service of the court’s notice the claim shall be stayed.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] (4) Any party may apply under Part 23 for the stay to be lifted. The application must include an explanation for the delay in proceeding with or responding to the claim.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.10.—(1) Where—] (5) If the claimant files a notice stating a wish that the proceedings should continue, the procedure set out in Part 26 shall apply.

## Claim stayed if it is not defended or admitted

## 15.11.—(1) Where—

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.11.—(1) Where—] (a)at least 6 months have expired since the end of the period for filing a defence specified in rule 15.4;

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.11.—(1) Where—] (b)no defendant has served or filed an admission or filed a defence or counterclaim; and

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.11.—(1) Where—] (c)no party has entered or applied for judgment under Part 12 (default judgment), or Part 24 (summary judgment); and

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.11.—(1) Where—] (d)no defendant has applied to strike out all or part of the claim form or particulars of claim,

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.11.—(1) Where—] the claim shall be stayed.

[PART 15 – DEFENCE AND REPLY > 15.11.—(1) Where—] (2) Any party may apply under Part 23 for the stay to be lifted. The application must include an explanation for the delay in proceeding with or responding to the claim.
